items.zh: 客家話有少部分字的聲母跟廣州話不同，要注意發音。
items.en: A small number of Hakka characters have different initial consonants compared to Cantonese. Pay attention to pronunciation.

items.zh: {{老}}在{老虎: lau4 fu3}、{老蟹: lau4 hai3}、{老鼠: lau4 cu3}中唸**第四聲** `làu` ，比較特別。其他情況唸**第三聲** `lău`。
items.en: {{老}} is pronounced with the **fourth tone** `làu` in 'tiger' ({老虎: lau4 fu3}), 'crab' ({老蟹: lau4 hai3}), and 'rat' ({老鼠: lau4 cu3}), which is quite special. In other cases, it is pronounced with the **third tone** `lău`.

items.zh: {{發}}在跟身體的病理或生理現象有關，或跟天氣現象有關時唸 `bŏt`。其他情況尤其是來自北方話的詞彙唸 `făt`。
items.en: {{發}} is pronounced `bŏt` when related to pathological/physiological phenomena or weather. In other cases, especially in vocabulary from Mandarin, it is pronounced `făt`.

items.zh: {兜: deu1}是「一些」的意思。例如{菜園種嗨兜青菜: coi4 yen2 | zung4 hoi1 deu1 | ciang1 coi4}。
items.en: {兜: deu1} means 'some'. For example: {菜園種嗨兜青菜: coi4 yen2 | zung4 hoi1 deu1 | ciang1 coi4} (The vegetable garden has planted some vegetables).
